messages:
alex: quick heads-up — noticed SDKs and Console are sending slightly different 429 payloads. this is causing confusion for customers and our retry libraries. we should standardize on a single shape and add an explicit retry hint + machine-readable reason code so clients can fallback.

maria: can you paste examples? iirc Node SDK returns `Retry-After` header only, python SDK returns body with seconds, and console shows a human sentence. that mismatch is the problem.

alex: exactly. examples below:

```json
// node-sdk current
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1.5
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded"
}

// python-sdk current
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "retry_after": 1.5
  }
}

// console toast
"You’ve hit your rate limit — try again in a couple seconds. Visit Billing -> Quotas to increase limits."
```

alex: proposal: adopt a unified, minimal, stable shape for all endpoints & SDKs:

```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limit",
  "code": "quota.burst_exhausted",
  "retry_after_seconds": 1.5,
  "quota_scope": "org", // or "key"
  "links": [
    {"rel": "console_quota", "href": "https://console.redwood.ai/quotas#org"}
  ]
}
```

alex: reason codes help implement nuanced fallbacks (e.g., "burst_exhausted" vs "sustained_limit").

devon: +1. we should also include a short guidance string to show in the console toast (human text) but keep it separate from the machine fields. e.g. `human_message`.

lisa: telemetry question — if we change the shape, how do we map existing events? we need to ensure dashboards & alerts don't break.

alex: plan: emit a compatibility event mapping old fields to new ones in the api gateway for 90 days, tag telemetry with `rl_schema=v2` so dashboards can filter/migrate. update Kibana queries + alert rules as part of the rollout.

jen (devex): wording for console: keep it actionable and non-technical. suggestion: "You're sending requests too quickly. We recommend batching or enabling burst mode in Dedicated. See troubleshooting and request examples." include a button: "Open quota settings" that links to the console_quota link.

devon: rollout plan: feature-flag the new shape behind `rl_schema_v2`. SDKs to start reading both new & old fields for a month. after telemetry shows <1% usages of old shape, cut the compatibility shim.

lisa: ops-bot can we schedule a traffic test? we should simulate per-key, per-org, and burst scenarios and verify the `code` values are set correctly.

ops-bot: scheduled load test for quota scenarios on 2026-05-02 23:00 UTC — test id: rl-schema-compat-20260502. will post results.

maria: docs updates: add a section "Handling rate limits" with example SDK snippet that checks `code` and `retry_after_seconds`, shows exponential backoff with jitter, and points to console quota UI. i'll open the PR for docs + a small section in quickstarts.

alex: small SDK change: make language clients expose `RateLimitError` typed exception with fields `code`, `retryAfter`, `quotaScope`, `links`. keep legacy fields available as aliases for now.

jen (devex): also add a short troubleshooting paragraph: "If you see `quota.burst_exhausted` frequently, consider increasing burst capacity or smoothing requests." link to best practices.

devon: technical: ensure proxies don't drop `Retry-After` header when we switch to body-first approach. prefer headers + body (dup of hint) for maximum compatibility.

alex: agree — include both header `Retry-After` (seconds) and canonical body fields. header stays for very simple clients; body for SDKs and console.

lisa: i'll update dashboards: map old `rate_limit_exceeded` event to new `code` tags, add a split on `quota_scope` so product can see per-org vs per-key spikes. will also add a new alert for unexpected `sustained_limit` increases.

maria: who owns the console copy change? jen?

jen (devex): i'll take it. i'll prepare variants and run a quick usability pass with support (they see the hits). can you add me to the docs PR, maria?

maria: added. opening PR now. title: "docs: standardize rate-limit payload + console UX". I'll include the sample payload and SDK guidance.

alex: thanks — timeline: aim to land gateway + telemetry changes this sprint, SDKs to support reading both shapes next sprint, console copy + button behind flag the sprint after. ops-bot will run the tests and we’ll validate telemetry before removing shims.

lisa: noted. tagging alerting folks after tests.

alex: ok — closing loop here. if anyone wants to take on the SDK fatal migration checklist ping me. otherwise i'll follow up with a short RFC doc.

maria: quick note: ping product as well so customers know about the more actionable console links and retry hints.

jen (devex): adding a small helpcenter article after docs PR merges. :+1:

alex: thanks everyone."
